source: FantasyPros consensus season projections, one CSV export per position, scored under this league's settings

fields.rank: Pool rank, 1..N, by points_1yr descending (ties broken by name). Unique and gap-free.
fields.positional_rank: Rank within position under the same ordering.
fields.player_id: Sleeper's player id as an integer; the pool's unique key.
fields.sleeper_id: The same id as the string Sleeper's API uses; joins draft.json and the investigator's boards.
fields.name: Player name as Sleeper prints it.
fields.position: QB, RB, WR or TE: FantasyPros' file, which agrees with Sleeper's listing.
fields.team: NFL team abbreviation per Sleeper; null when unsigned.
fields.age: Age in years per Sleeper; null when Sleeper does not know it.
fields.points_1yr: Projected 2026 fantasy points: FantasyPros' consensus stat line scored under this league's settings (see 'scoring').
